changes.change: DMSDevicePayloadStore host-pack staging trio (pack_k/pack_v/pack_evict) is now lazy: allocated on first host-composition pack_layer call, sized at the constructor's max_pack_rows (the copy-size guard is preserved). The device-pointer path (pack_layer_device / device_streaming_pack_layer, used by the layer_outer DMS route) never stages through host memory and now allocates none of it.
changes.saving_note: at the layer_outer route's max_pack_rows=min(tokens,4096): 4096 x (2x4x256x2 + 4) = 16.01 MiB of device memory no longer allocated on the device-pointer route
changes.test: tests/test_dms_int8_device_payloads.py::test_device_pointer_pack_route_skips_host_pack_staging (RED pre-fix: resident_bytes differed by max_pack_rows at construction; GREEN post-fix; tracked bytes zero after close)

changes.change: _ExternalDMSDevicePrefillCollector logits plane is sized by selection mode: exact_budget keeps the full [layers, tokens, heads] FP32 plane (finalize runs the cross-layer global budget over it); every other sidecar selection gets one layer's worth shared across layers (logits are write-only kernel scratch there; captures are stream-ordered per layer). Decisions remain full-size in all modes.
changes.saving_note: at 256K tokens x 16 layers x 4 heads x FP32: exact_budget requires the full 64 MiB (kept); threshold routes drop from 64 MiB to 4 MiB (60 MiB saved). The audit's route (exact_budget) sees no change - the plane is genuinely read by the global eviction budget.
changes.test: tests/test_dms_external_linear_hip.py::test_collector_logits_sized_by_selection_mode (RED pre-fix: threshold-mode logits were full-size; GREEN post-fix)

changes.change: No new runtime code: the mid-pack teardown landed with the layerwise campaign (_ensure_layer per-buffer rollback; the layer_outer pack pass closes the partially built backend on BaseException). This unit adds the missing proof: a simulated mid-pack allocation failure rolls the partial layer back to zero, the registry returns to its pre-attempt level, the store remains usable (retry succeeds), and close drains every tracked byte.
changes.test: tests/test_dms_int8_device_payloads.py::test_midpack_allocation_failure_rolls_back_and_store_is_reusable (simulated MemoryError on the second per-layer allocation; rollback + reuse + zero-after-close asserted)

measurement_note: Device-side spot measurements ran on GPU0 (W7900, same gfx1100 arch and kernel package) because GPU1 was occupied by an external benchmark during this unit; the quantities are allocator-visible bytes asserted in the tests (arch-independent within gfx1100).
